decisions.reason: A hyaluronic acid serum is a popular, low-cost complement to the facial care range that small-batch production sustains easily, so withdrawal after two years is unlikely.
A cleansing milk is a basic staple of natural facial care that anchors the cleansing range and is cheap to keep in a batch-based assortment.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and fits the established offer, and the firm usually gives new products time to find customers before reviewing them.
